calpol.safetyTip: Safe in pregnancy. Avoid excess doses.

combiflam.safetyTip: Avoid on empty stomach. Risk of GI bleed.

brufen.safetyTip: Avoid in kidney disease and peptic ulcer.

zerodol.safetyTip: Avoid in GI ulcers. Monitor BP.

zerodol th.safetyTip: For musculoskeletal pain. Avoid in pregnancy.

voveran.safetyTip: Risk of CV events with long-term use.

naxdom 500.safetyTip: For migraine. Avoid in peptic ulcer.

tramazac.safetyTip: Do not drive. Risk of dependence.

fortwin.safetyTip: Hospital use only. High dependence risk.

nimulid.safetyTip: Not for children under 12. Liver risk.

augmentin.safetyTip: Take with food to reduce GI upset.

mox.safetyTip: Complete full course. Check for allergy.

ciplox.safetyTip: Risk of tendon rupture with steroids.

zithromax.safetyTip: 3-5 day course only. Take 1hr before food.

clavam.safetyTip: Take with meals. Check penicillin allergy.

taxim o.safetyTip: Complete full course. GI side effects common.

eryacne.safetyTip: Take on empty stomach for best absorption.

erythrocin.safetyTip: Interacts with many drugs. Check interactions.

flagyl.safetyTip: No alcohol. Metallic taste is common.

norflox.safetyTip: Take on empty stomach. Avoid antacids.

oflox.safetyTip: Avoid in children. QTc prolongation risk.

doxycycline.safetyTip: Take with full glass of water. Avoid dairy.

septra.safetyTip: Risk of sulfa allergy. Stay hydrated.

pan 40.safetyTip: Take 30 min before meals for best effect.

pantop.safetyTip: Long-term use may affect magnesium levels.

rabifast.safetyTip: Take before first meal of the day.

nexium.safetyTip: Most potent PPI. Monitor bone density.

gelusil.safetyTip: Take 1-3hr after meals. Reduces drug absorption.

digene.safetyTip: Shake well before use. Do not give to infants.

mucaine.safetyTip: Contains local anesthetic. Spit or swallow as directed.

meftal spas.safetyTip: Common for dysmenorrhea. Avoid in peptic ulcer.

cyclopam.safetyTip: For GI spasms. May cause dry mouth.

perinorm.safetyTip: Risk of tardive dyskinesia with long use.

enterogermina.safetyTip: Safe for all ages. No refrigeration needed.

eldoper.safetyTip: For acute diarrhea only. Max 3 days.

stamlo.safetyTip: Take at same time daily. Monitor for edema.

aten.safetyTip: Do not stop suddenly. Monitor heart rate.

tenormin.safetyTip: Avoid in asthma. Do not stop abruptly.

betaloc.safetyTip: Take with meals. Cardioselective beta blocker.

arkamin.safetyTip: Do not stop suddenly — rebound hypertension.

tozaar.safetyTip: Avoid in pregnancy. Monitor renal function.

repace.safetyTip: Good for hypertension + uric acid reduction.

hopace.safetyTip: Avoid in pregnancy. Dry cough common SE.

aceten.safetyTip: Take on empty stomach for best absorption.

envas.safetyTip: Monitor BP. Dry cough is common side effect.

storvas.safetyTip: Take in evening. Monitor liver enzymes.

rosuvas.safetyTip: Most potent statin. Monitor for myopathy.

crestor.safetyTip: Check CK if muscle pain develops.

lescol.safetyTip: Fewer drug interactions than other statins.

lopid.safetyTip: Take 30 min before meals. Statin interaction.

glycomet.safetyTip: Take with food to reduce GI upset.

glyree.safetyTip: Take before breakfast. Risk of hypoglycemia.

amaryl.safetyTip: Monitor blood glucose. Carry glucose tablets.

pioz.safetyTip: Risk of fluid retention. Avoid in heart failure.

actos.safetyTip: Bladder cancer risk with long-term use.

galvus.safetyTip: Low hypoglycemia risk. Monitor liver enzymes.

zita.safetyTip: Good safety profile. Monitor renal function.

forxiga.safetyTip: Risk of UTI. Stay hydrated. Also for heart failure.

mixtard.safetyTip: Inject 30 min before meals. Monitor glucose.

eltroxin.safetyTip: Take on empty stomach, 30 min before breakfast.

thyrox.safetyTip: Never miss doses. Regular TSH monitoring needed.

eptoin.safetyTip: Monitor drug levels. Many drug interactions.

dilantin.safetyTip: Narrow therapeutic index. Level monitoring essential.

gabantin.safetyTip: Causes drowsiness. Do not drive initially.

pregeb.safetyTip: Scheduled drug. Dizziness and weight gain common.

lyrica.safetyTip: Risk of misuse. Monitor for edema.

levipil.safetyTip: Well tolerated. Monitor for mood changes.

topirol.safetyTip: Risk of kidney stones. Stay hydrated.

epitomax.safetyTip: Cognitive side effects. Causes weight loss.

nexito.safetyTip: Takes 2-4 weeks to work. Do not stop suddenly.

sertraline.safetyTip: Gradual dose increase. GI side effects common.

pexep.safetyTip: Do not stop abruptly — discontinuation syndrome.

veniz.safetyTip: Monitor BP. Do not stop abruptly.

mirtaz.safetyTip: Take at bedtime. Improves sleep and appetite.

alprax.safetyTip: High dependence risk. Short-term use only.

zapiz.safetyTip: Also used for epilepsy. Tolerance develops.

rivotril.safetyTip: Long-acting BZD. Do not stop abruptly.

serenace.safetyTip: Risk of EPS. Monitor for tardive dyskinesia.

zyprexa.safetyTip: Weight gain and sedation are common SEs.

lithosun.safetyTip: Monitor blood levels. Narrow therapeutic window.

tryptomer.safetyTip: Take at night. Also used for neuropathic pain.

asthalin.safetyTip: Rescue inhaler. Do not use >4 times/day.

ventolin.safetyTip: Shake well before use. Rinse mouth after.

foracort.safetyTip: Rinse mouth after use to prevent thrush.

seroflo.safetyTip: Not for acute attacks. Maintenance therapy only.

flomist.safetyTip: For allergic rhinitis. Shake well before use.

budecort.safetyTip: For asthma control. Rinse mouth after.

spiriva.safetyTip: Do not swallow capsule. Inhale only.

montair.safetyTip: Take at bedtime. For asthma + allergic rhinitis.

neurobion.generic: Vitamin B1 + Vitamin B6 + Vitamin B12
neurobion.safetyTip: For neuropathy. Safe for long-term use.

calvit.safetyTip: Take with meals for best absorption.

shelcal.safetyTip: Do not take with iron supplements simultaneously.

d-cal.safetyTip: For bone health. Monitor calcium levels.

cobadex forte.generic: Vitamin B Complex + Vitamin C + Zinc

livogen.safetyTip: Stool may turn black. Take with Vitamin C.

orofer s.safetyTip: IV use only. Monitor for anaphylaxis.

eleva.safetyTip: For B12 deficiency. Long acting form.

methylcobalamin.safetyTip: Active form of B12. Safe long-term.

ecosprin.safetyTip: Take after food. Risk of GI bleed.

deplatt.safetyTip: Do not stop without doctor advice post-stent.

brillinta.safetyTip: More potent than clopidogrel. Risk of dyspnea.

warfarin.safetyTip: Narrow therapeutic index. Vitamin K interactions.

eliquis.safetyTip: No monitoring needed. Avoid in severe renal disease.

xarelto.safetyTip: Take with evening meal. Renal dose adjustment needed.

dabigatran.safetyTip: Do not crush capsule. Monitor renal function.

clexane.safetyTip: Subcutaneous injection. Monitor anti-Xa in pregnancy.

urimax.safetyTip: For BPH. Risk of orthostatic hypotension.

finpecia.safetyTip: For hair loss. Teratogenic — women must not handle.

proscar.safetyTip: For BPH. Reduces PSA levels — inform urologist.

timolol.safetyTip: Systemic absorption possible. Caution in asthma.

wysolone.safetyTip: Take in morning. Do not stop abruptly.

dexamethasone.safetyTip: Potent steroid. Monitor glucose and BP.

medrol.safetyTip: Take after breakfast. Avoid NSAIDs with this.

lariago.safetyTip: Also used for rheumatoid arthritis. Eye check annually.

p-alaxin.safetyTip: Take with fatty food for absorption.

malarone.safetyTip: For malaria prevention. Start 1-2 days before travel.

zentel.safetyTip: Single dose for most infections. Take with fatty meal.

canditral.safetyTip: Take with main meal. Many drug interactions.

sporanox.safetyTip: Negative inotrope — avoid in heart failure.

zovirax.safetyTip: Stay well hydrated. For herpes simplex/zoster.

tamiflu.safetyTip: Start within 48 hours of flu symptoms.
